analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The patch adds one paragraph at head lines 1584-1592 about tokenizer decode spacing. It says LocalTokenizerLoader resolves an absent clean_up_tokenization_spaces key to false in memory and keeps an explicit Boolean, with no effect on input IDs, sampling or cache keys. The supplied units are base-text excerpts at lines 4003-4494. They are far from the changed hunk and are unchanged context: GLM and Qwen tensor-parallel, the SSD prefix record encoding, GPT-OSS and Gemma notes. I found no change to code, trust boundaries, keys, attestation, authorization, encryption, prefix-cache scoping (T-041), or the coordinator-provider protocol. The claim that cache keys are independent of the setting is documentation only. The LocalTokenizerLoader.swift source was not supplied, so I could not verify it. A decode-side tokenizer config change affects output text and streaming correctness, and the prose does not suggest a confidentiality effect. No threat-model update is needed from this doc change. Remaining uncertainty: whether the actual loader change, if present elsewhere in the PR, handles malformed or non-Boolean config values safely. It is outside these units.
